import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class CF939F_V1 {
    static final int INF = (int) 1e8;
    static BufferedReader input;
    static PrintWriter output;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        if (System.getProperty("ONLINE_JUDGE") == null) {
            input = new BufferedReader(new FileReader("D:\\DataBase\\TESTCASE\\codeforces\\CF939F.in"));
        } else {
            input = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        }
        output = new PrintWriter(new BufferedOutputStream(System.out));
        
        solve();
        output.flush();
    }

    static void solve() throws IOException {
        int n = Integer.parseInt(input.readLine().trim());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(input.readLine().trim());
        
        int[][] intervals = new int[k + 2][2];
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            String[] parts = input.readLine().trim().split("\\s+");
            intervals[i][0] = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
            intervals[i][1] = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);
        }
        intervals[k + 1][0] = 2 * n;
        intervals[k + 1][1] = 2 * n;
        k++;

        SegmentTree[] loop = new SegmentTree[2];
        loop[0] = new SegmentTree(0, n);
        loop[1] = new SegmentTree(0, n);

        int[] data = new int[n + 1];

        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            SegmentTree curDp = loop[i & 1];
            SegmentTree lastDp = loop[(i - 1) & 1];

            int[] interval = intervals[i];
            int intervalLength = interval[1] - interval[0];
            int middleLength = interval[0] - intervals[i - 1][1];

            lastDp.toArray(data);
            System.arraycopy(data, 0, data, intervalLength + middleLength, n + 1 - (intervalLength + middleLength));
            Arrays.fill(data, 0, intervalLength + middleLength, INF);

            int minX = interval[1] - middleLength - intervalLength;
            int maxX = interval[1] - middleLength;
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                int minNeedTime = lastDp.query(minX - j, maxX - j);
                data[j] = Math.min(data[j], minNeedTime + 1);
            }

            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                int minNeedTime = lastDp.query(interval[1] - intervalLength, interval[1]);
                data[j] = Math.min(data[j], minNeedTime + 2);
            }

            curDp.fromArray(data);
        }

        int minFlipTime = loop[k & 1].query(n, n);

        if (minFlipTime < INF) {
            output.println("Full");
            output.println(minFlipTime);
        } else {
            output.println("Hungry");
        }
    }

    static class SegmentTree {
        Node root;
        int n;

        SegmentTree(int l, int r) {
            n = r;
            root = build(l, r);
        }

        Node build(int l, int r) {
            Node node = new Node(l, r);
            if (l != r) {
                int m = (l + r) >> 1;
                node.left = build(l, m);
                node.right = build(m + 1, r);
                node.pushUp();
            }
            return node;
        }

        void setValue(int f, int t, int val) {
            setValue(root, f, t, val);
        }

        void setValue(Node node, int f, int t, int val) {
            if (f > node.r || t < node.l) return;
            if (f <= node.l && t >= node.r) {
                node.setValue(val);
                return;
            }
            node.pushDown();
            setValue(node.left, f, t, val);
            setValue(node.right, f, t, val);
            node.pushUp();
        }

        int query(int f, int t) {
            return query(root, f, t);
        }

        int query(Node node, int f, int t) {
            if (f > node.r || t < node.l) return INF;
            if (f <= node.l && t >= node.r) return node.min;
            node.pushDown();
            return Math.min(query(node.left, f, t), query(node.right, f, t));
        }

        void update(int i, int val) {
            update(root, i, val);
        }

        void update(Node node, int i, int val) {
            if (i < node.l || i > node.r) return;
            if (i == node.l && i == node.r) {
                node.min = Math.min(node.min, val);
                return;
            }
            node.pushDown();
            update(node.left, i, val);
            update(node.right, i, val);
            node.pushUp();
        }

        void toArray(int[] data) {
            toArray(root, data);
        }

        void toArray(Node node, int[] data) {
            if (node.l == node.r) {
                data[node.l] = node.min;
                return;
            }
            node.pushDown();
            toArray(node.left, data);
            toArray(node.right, data);
        }

        void fromArray(int[] data) {
            fromArray(root, data);
        }

        void fromArray(Node node, int[] data) {
            if (node.l == node.r) {
                node.min = data[node.l];
                return;
            }
            node.dirty = false;
            fromArray(node.left, data);
            fromArray(node.right, data);
            node.pushUp();
        }
    }

    static class Node {
        Node left, right;
        int l, r;
        int batchSetValue;
        boolean dirty;
        int min;

        Node(int l, int r) {
            this.l = l;
            this.r = r;
            min = INF;
        }

        void pushUp() {
            min = Math.min(left.min, right.min);
        }

        void setValue(int val) {
            min = val;
            batchSetValue = val;
            dirty = true;
        }

        void pushDown() {
            if (dirty) {
                left.setValue(batchSetValue);
                right.setValue(batchSetValue);
                dirty = false;
            }
        }
    }
}
